# spirl_event_subscription (Resource)

Delivers the organization's events to an HTTPS URL, authenticated with a SPIFFE JWT-SVID. While `enabled`, Defakto sends the URL a verification event before saving.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deliver SVID-issued events from one trust domain to an HTTPS endpoint.
resource "spirl_event_subscription" "svid_events" {
  url              = "https://events.example.com/spirl"
  event_types      = ["svid-issued"]
  trust_domain_ids = [spirl_trust_domain.my_domain.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (Set of String) The event types to deliver. One or more of: `svid-issued`.
- `url` (String) The HTTPS URL events are delivered to. Must be unique within the organization. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are delivered. A subscription that is not enabled is retained but receives no events. Defaults to `true`.
- `trust_domain_ids` (Set of String) The trust domains whose events are delivered. Omit to deliver events from every trust domain, including ones created later.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An RFC3339 timestamp for when the event subscription was created
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the event subscription
- `updated_at` (String) An RFC3339 timestamp for when the event subscription was last updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash

# Event subscription import uses the event subscription id
terraform import spirl_event_subscription.svid_events esub-123456
```
